data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing YouTube video resource and its selected metadata parts. An agent can modify video details for an existing video.
Use for: edit video metadata, update selected video parts, manage partner-owned video details
Not supported: video uploads, video deletion, analytics retrieval

data.name: Videos: update
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates metadata for an existing YouTube video. An agent can change the video's editable details.
Use for: edit video metadata, revise video details, update an existing video
Not supported: video uploads, video deletion, analytics retrieval

data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing YouTube video resource and its selected metadata parts. An agent can modify video details for an existing video.
Use for: edit video metadata, update selected video parts, manage partner-owned video details
Not supported: video uploads, video deletion, analytics retrieval

meta.q: Use YouTube Data API to update an existing video with English default metadata and localized titles/descriptions in six languages, then publish that same video publicly. Identify OAuth scopes and preserve metadata on partial updates.
